<?php
class Probe177MethodParent {
    public static function make() {
        return new class (5) extends Probe177MethodParent {
            protected function __construct(public int $value) { echo 'BODY;'; }
            final public function read(): int { return $this->value; }
        };
    }
}
$object = Probe177MethodParent::make();
echo $object->read(), ';', $object::class, ';';

<?php
$before = new class {};
class Probe178TypedFactory {
    public static function make(int $value = 3): self {
        return new class ($value) extends Probe178TypedFactory {
            protected function __construct(public int $value) {}
            public function read(): int { return $this->value; }
        };
    }
}
$after = new class {};
$first = Probe178TypedFactory::make();
$second = Probe178TypedFactory::make(8);
echo $before::class, ';', $first::class, ';', $after::class, ';';
echo $first->read(), ';', $second->read(), ';', $first::class === $second::class ? 'same;' : 'BAD;', $first === $second ? 'BAD;' : 'fresh;';

<?php
class Probe178InstanceFactory {
    private int $seed = 2;
    public function make(int $value = 3): self {
        echo __CLASS__, ';';
        return new class ($this->seed + $value) extends Probe178InstanceFactory {
            protected function __construct(public int $value) {}
            public function read(): int { return $this->value; }
        };
    }
}
$factory = new Probe178InstanceFactory;
$first = $factory->make();
$second = $factory->make(8);
$third = $first->make(1);
echo $first->read(), ';', $second->read(), ';', $third->read(), ';';
echo $first::class === $third::class ? 'same;' : 'BAD;', $first === $third ? 'BAD;' : 'fresh;', $first::class, ';';

<?php
class Probe178Pair {
    public static function left() { return new class { public function tag(): string { return 'L;'; } }; }
    public static function right() { return new class { public function tag(): string { return 'R;'; } }; }
}
$right = Probe178Pair::right();
$left = Probe178Pair::left();
$again = Probe178Pair::right();
echo $right::class, ';', $left::class, ';', $again::class, ';';
echo $right->tag(), $left->tag(), $again->tag(), $right::class === $again::class ? 'same;' : 'BAD;', $right === $again ? 'BAD;' : 'fresh;';

<?php
namespace Probe178Library {
    class Ancestor { protected function inherited(): string { return 'base;'; } }
}
namespace Probe178App {
    use Probe178Library\Ancestor as AncestorAlias;
    use Probe178App\Factory as OwnerAlias;
    class Factory extends AncestorAlias {
        public static function make(int $value = 5): self {
            return new class ($value) extends OwnerAlias {
                protected function __construct(public int $value) {}
                public function read(): string { return $this->inherited() . $this->value . ';'; }
            };
        }
    }
    $object = Factory::make();
    echo $object->read(), $object::class, ';';
}

<?php
readonly class Probe178ReadonlyFactory {
    public static function make(int $value = 5): self {
        return new readonly class ($value) extends Probe178ReadonlyFactory {
            protected function __construct(public int $value) {}
            public function read(): int { return $this->value; }
        };
    }
}
$object = Probe178ReadonlyFactory::make();
echo $object->read(), ';', $object::class, ';';
try { $object->value = 9; } catch (Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), ';'; }
echo $object->value, ';';

<?php
class Probe178FinalParent { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
function probe178Argument() { echo 'ARG;'; return 5; }
class Probe178ConflictFactory {
    public static function make() {
        echo 'enter;';
        return new class (probe178Argument()) extends Probe178FinalParent {
            public function __construct(public int $field) { echo 'BODY;'; }
            public function value(): int { return 2; }
        };
    }
}
echo 'before;';
$object = Probe178ConflictFactory::make();
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class Probe178SkippedParent { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
function probe178Argument() { echo 'ARG;'; return 5; }
class Probe178SkippedFactory {
    public static function make() {
        return new class (probe178Argument()) extends Probe178SkippedParent {
            public function __construct(public int $field) { echo 'BODY;'; }
            public function value(): int { return 2; }
        };
    }
}
echo 'skipped;';

<?php
$before = new class {};
if (true) {
    class Probe178ConditionalFactory {
        public static function make() { return new class { public function value(): string { return 'late;'; } }; }
    }
}
$after = new class {};
$first = Probe178ConditionalFactory::make();
$second = Probe178ConditionalFactory::make();
echo $before::class, ';', $first::class, ';', $after::class, ';';
echo $first->value(), $first::class === $second::class ? 'same;' : 'BAD;';

<?php
class Probe178ReferenceFactory {
    public static function make(int &$value): self {
        return new class ($value) extends Probe178ReferenceFactory {
            protected function __construct(public int &$value) {}
        };
    }
}
$value = 4;
$object = Probe178ReferenceFactory::make($value);
$object->value = 8;
echo $value, ';';
try { $value = []; } catch (TypeError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), ';'; }
echo $value, ';', $object->value, ';', $object::class, ';';

<?php
class Probe178ScopeParent {}
function probe178Argument() { echo 'ARG;'; return 5; }
class Probe178UnrelatedFactory {
    public static function make() {
        return new class (probe178Argument()) extends Probe178ScopeParent {
            protected function __construct(public int $value) { echo 'BODY;'; }
        };
    }
}
echo 'before;';
try { $object = Probe178UnrelatedFactory::make(); } catch (Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), ';'; }
echo 'after;';

<?php
echo 'before;';
class Probe178InvalidFactory {
    public static function make() {
        return new readonly class {
            public int $value = 1;
        };
    }
}
echo 'BAD;';
